messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v3.2.1 -> 5% (canary) in eu-west. Change window until 16:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.example/release/v3.2.1 :rocket:
carla: saw a small p95 tail increase on encoder hosts ~+120ms since shift, sampling qps steady. no user-facing errors yet. :mag:
maria: can we hold at 5% until we confirm tail isn't correlated to kv-cache pressure? requesting stop/go. :hand:
dave: +1 hold. pin canary to v3.2.1 and don't advance traffic. rollback triggers: error-rate >0.5% OR p95 >500ms sustained for 5m. rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to v3.1.9 --scope canary`
ops-amber: logs show repeated kvcache evictions on enc-0: `evict: keys=432 size=1.2G` — pasting excerpt:
```
Mar 23 14:34 enc-0 INFO kvcache evict keys=432 reason=oom_estimate size=1.2G
Mar 23 14:35 enc-0 WARN slowpath token_latency=620ms req_id=abc123
```
ops-amber: taking a heap/profile snapshot, will attach when ready. :warning:
ben: release notes updated with the known tail issue + mitigation steps (link above). docs/upgrade guide also mentions pinning instructions. :memo:
deploy-bot: Paused traffic shift per ops request. Canary remains at 5% and is pinned. Notifying oncall.
carla: proposing a small config tweak — reduce encoder batch target from 32 -> 24 and reconverge kv cache TTL to 30s. estimate 8-12m to apply and observe.
dave: schedule the change at 14:45 UTC. if p95 drops below baseline within 10m after change, raise lift-vote. otherwise we keep pinned and prepare rollback. @natalie-oncall please ack and watch metrics. :eyes:
natalie-oncall: ack — watching dashboards and traces. will post updates in 10m. :white_check_mark:
